offence_note: Two counts of sexual interference with person under 16
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal and vary the global sentence by reducing it to four years. After granting 18 months' credit for pre-sentence custody, I would impose an effective sentence of two and a half years.
note: s. 161 prohibitions reduced from 20 years to two years

sentence_quote: I have concluded that a sentence of six years is fit and appropriate.
note: Reasons for Laidlaw only; co-accused sentenced in separate reasons.

offence_note: Assaults on a child by young person (breach of trust)
sentence_quote: The sentence was not manifestly excessive or unreasonable given the nature of the assaults, the child's age and the breach of trust.
note: Youth appeal; jail term length not shown; only probation varied to allow contact with son.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence imposed is varied to twelve months imprisonment.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for purpose of trafficking (1 kg)
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, set aside the order of the sentencing judge, and order that the appellant be ordered to serve a term of imprisonment of two years less one day to be served conditionally.
note: Three-year jail term replaced by conditional sentence mainly because of seven-year delay; offender is aboriginal, no Gladue analysis.

offence_note: Importing large quantity of cocaine and hashish (pilot)
note: Sentence length not shown in the endorsement.

offence_note: Conspiracy to import 100 kilograms of drugs
sentence_quote: In our view, this sentence including the period of parole ineligibility was fit and there were no errors in principle.
note: Very lengthy consecutive sentence with parole ineligibility order; length not shown.

offence_note: Aiding production and possession for trafficking of marihuana
sentence_quote: impose the sentence and related orders made by the trial judge - that is, 20 months' incarceration concurrent on each of the counts of production of marihuana and possession for the purpose of trafficking in marihuana.
note: Conspiracy convictions quashed, substantive counts substituted; same sentence; five-year default term if fine unpaid.

offence_note: Break and enter and other offences
sentence_quote: Accordingly, leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence is reduced to a total of fifteen months' imprisonment.
note: Other offences not identified; original sentence length not shown.

offence_note: Sexual interference, sexual exploitation, sexual assault of stepdaughter
sentence_quote: I find that a sentence of seven and one‑half years' imprisonment on Counts 1 and 3 to be served concurrently is the appropriate sentence.
note: Three years concurrent on Count 4; invitation count conditionally stayed; deportation consequences declined as mitigation.

offence_note: Impaired driving causing death of daughter
sentence_quote: The Crown appeals the conditional sentence of two years less a day imposed by The Honourable Judge Lazar of the Provincial Court on 21 July 1999
note: Crown appeal dismissed; conditions included residential program if directed by supervisor.

offence_note: Impaired driving and impaired driving causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: The six month conditional sentence is set aside and a five month period of incarceration substituted therefor to commence as of this date.
note: Conditional sentence replaced by jail; driving prohibitions 1 year plus 4 years consecutive; probation curfew extended.
